src/sprout/rag/answer.py line ~210: the note is skipped whenever the text contains 'product label', so the rule 'label and local rules' is satisfied by the label alone. 5 of 25 served answers with chemical words say label but not local rules (supported-012, 014, 015, 034, ambiguous-011).
notes: Verdict is FAIL only on the chemical and disposal label rule (a CLAUDE.md never-bend rule); everything else I could check holds. The fix is small: widen CHEMICAL (disinfectants, bleach/chlorine, TSP, oils, sulfur, burn/bury/destroy/discard), require both 'label' and 'local' (else append the note), and add test cases; the E7 faithfulness/decline numbers do not depend on the note (split_claims skips it), so no E7 rerun is needed. Gaps for later tasks. For T6.6: use E7-prompts-v2-6f0bf200.{judgments,blind}.jsonl (506 answers, 101 questions) and E7-claude-v2-4e89cfd6.* (112); ignore the older E7-prompts-v2-20261103 and E7-prompts-v2-2173a13c copies (same 'served' rows with the base prompt, 0.799). The blind file shows the 'system' name (base/served/...), which could bias a grader; the local judge scores only the cited passages, or all passages when a claim cites none, and counts decline sentences ('the evidence does not cover...') as unsupported claims, so the 0.851 faithfulness is not comparable to a Sonnet grade without reading both directions. The judge missed a wrong-disease transfer (supported-031, strawberry leaf scorch advice taken from a wilt passage), so expect some flattering in the local judge. For T7.4: wire answer() with crop= set from the identified or chosen label (as web/analyses.py does) or from the question text; with neither, a tomato question can cite a potato passage. The E7 'wrong_crop' protection came from the harness detect_crop, not from answer(). Serving rerank on CPU ONNX is ~600 ms per search (p50 604, p95 976) and matches GPU ranks and scores; the floors were chosen at k=10 but serving uses k=5. Model prose declines are counted answered and keep their citations (5 of 14 wrong_crop rows, 1 not_in_documents row); NO_SUPPORT is only detected at the start of a reply, so a trailing 'NO_SUPPORT' leaks into the user text; the UI should not show a source list under a decline. Ambiguous questions are answered 61.5% of the time (declines_when_ambiguous 0.385), wrong_crop declines 0.643 at the measured level, and the floors/prompt were chosen on rag_dev so are optimistic. For T8.1: the headline numbers are development numbers (n=101, with prompt gains within noise; faithfulness 0.851 is a local-judge value); do not state them as a claim until T6.6 and a rag_test run. Five of the 11 unconfirmed-source documents are cited often, so citation status 'source not confirmed' will show in many answers. Minor: superseded E7 records are marked only in docs/DECISIONS.md, not in the record files; Claude call counter 125 vs 124 summed from records.
